tools.name: request_login_otp
tools.description: Send ChowDeck login SMS (validate phone → auth/login). Does not accept OTP. Ask the user for their phone first, then for the SMS code, then call verify_login_otp.

tools.name: verify_login_otp
tools.description: Complete ChowDeck login with SMS code (validate phone → validate OTP → refresh token). Does not send a new SMS.

tools.name: fetch_customer_settings
tools.description: Public customer app config (no auth). Good session probe.

tools.name: view_cart
tools.description: View current cart contents.

tools.name: get_addresses
tools.description: Run the get_addresses pipeline.

tools.name: get_payment_methods
tools.description: Run the get_payment_methods pipeline.

tools.name: list_orders_success
tools.description: Run the list_orders_success pipeline.

tools.name: get_order_details
tools.description: Run the get_order_details pipeline.

tools.name: get_customer_survey
tools.description: Run the get_customer_survey pipeline.

tools.name: set_active_address_and_fetch_menu
tools.description: Set active delivery address and fetch chowsmart menu for that address.

tools.name: get_featured_vendors
tools.description: Featured and tagged vendors near a delivery address.

tools.name: get_chowpass_status
tools.description: Run the get_chowpass_status pipeline.

tools.name: search_menu_by_address
tools.description: Run the search_menu_by_address pipeline.

tools.name: search_product
tools.description: Search vendors/products by name near a delivery address. Each data[] entry: id = vendor id; products[].id = menu item id when present. If products[] empty, call view_vendor_items next.

tools.name: get_country_list
tools.description: Run the get_country_list pipeline.

tools.name: view_vendor_cart
tools.description: View cart for one vendor (vendor-specific checkout view).

tools.name: remove_cart_item
tools.description: Remove one line item (pack) from a vendor cart. POST /customer/cart/vendor/{vendor_id} with quantity 0. Run view_vendor_cart first — pass menu line ids from data.cart_items[] (type menu). Side-effect.

tools.name: duplicate_cart_pack
tools.description: Increase quantity by duplicating one pack (configured line item). POST /customer/cart/{cart_id}/pack/{pack_reference}/duplicate. Run view_vendor_cart first. Side-effect.

tools.name: clear_vendor_cart
tools.description: Delete/clear the entire cart for one vendor (all items). Requires cart id from view_vendor_cart response data.id — not vendor id. Side-effect: use when user wants to empty cart or before re-adding after 'Active cart already exists'.

tools.name: view_vendor_items
tools.description: Load a vendor menu. Pass vendor id from search_product data[].id as step_58_url_path_2 before add_item_to_cart when search products[] is empty.

tools.name: add_item_to_cart
tools.description: Add an item to cart. Requires vendor id + menu item id from search_product (products[]) or view_vendor_items. Always pass item type menu.

tools.name: view_wallet_balance
tools.description: Retrieve the user's wallet balance.

tools.name: get_delivery_amount_for_order
tools.description: Fetch delivery fee details for an order.

tools.name: place_order
tools.description: Place order with Pay for me — returns pay_for_me_url for the user to complete payment in browser.
